metadata.description: Personal curated set of Claude skills, installable the same way in Claude Code and Cowork.

plugins.name: arsenal-guide
plugins.description: Tells Claude what tools you have and how your voice setup works, so it picks the right one without being reminded. Install this everywhere.

plugins.name: motion-kit
plugins.description: High-end motion graphics: Remotion (code-built typography, GFX, transitions), a Vox/MOX documentary style guide with sound-design and mix standards, and a QA bar against basic edits.

plugins.name: free-ai-kit
plugins.description: Free local AI for video on an Intel Mac: Real-ESRGAN upscaling, RIFE slow motion, rembg cut-outs, Depth Anything V2 depth maps for 2.5D parallax.

plugins.name: design-kit
plugins.description: Design skills: landing pages, Figma, design direction, design systems, HTML slides, brand voice and discovery, motion, accessibility.

plugins.name: voice-kit
plugins.description: Drive a locally running VoiceStudio app (text-to-speech, voice design, transcription, dubbing). Needs VoiceStudio installed on the same computer.

plugins.name: ffmpeg-skill
plugins.description: Local FFmpeg video/audio editing: cut, join, reframe, captions, silence removal, loudness, platform exports. Needs FFmpeg 6.1+ and Python 3.10+ on the same computer.

plugins.name: cli-hub
plugins.description: Find and install CLI-Anything tools for desktop apps (GIMP, Blender, OBS, Inkscape, Audacity, LibreOffice...) on demand. Needs Python and pip on the same computer.

plugins.name: cli-anything
plugins.description: Official CLI-Anything plugin: /cli-anything commands to build, test and refine a new agent-ready CLI for any app that does not have one yet.

plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Developer helpers: find a free public API for any task (public-apis catalog with keyword, auth, HTTPS and CORS filters). Needs Python 3.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: impeccable.style: one design skill with 24 commands (/impeccable polish, audit, critique...) and anti-pattern detection for frontend work. Runs a small checker after edits.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: tasteskill.dev: professional company websites at a high design bar, checked in a real browser. Needs Node.js.

plugins.name: emil-design
plugins.description: Emil Kowalski's 20 design-engineering skills: animation, motion, gestures, polish, UI stress-testing, Apple-style design.
